PREFIX zaguan: PREFIX xsd: PREFIX rdf: PREFIX rdfs:
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc rdf:type ?type . FILTER (?type = zaguan:TFG || ?type = zaguan:TFM) .
?doc zaguan:title ?title . ?doc zaguan:date ?date . ?doc zaguan:language ?lang .
FILTER (?lang = "spa") .
?doc zaguan:subject ?subj . ?subj zaguan:nombreTema ?tema .
FILTER( ( CONTAINS(LCASE(?tema), "animación") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?tema), "visión por computador") ) )
FILTER (?date >= "2005"^^xsd:gYear) .
} LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: PREFIX xsd: PREFIX rdf: PREFIX rdfs:
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc zaguan:title ?title . ?doc zaguan:date ?date .
?doc zaguan:subject ?subj . ?subj zaguan:nombreTema ?tema .
?doc zaguan:description ?desc .
FILTER( (CONTAINS(LCASE(?tema), "veterinaria"))
( CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "felinos") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "caninos") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "gatos") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "perros") ) )
FILTER (?date >= "2012"^^xsd:gYear && ?date <= "2018"^^xsd:gYear) . } LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: PREFIX xsd: PREFIX rdf: PREFIX rdfs:
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc rdf:type ?type . FILTER (?type = zaguan:TFG || ?type = zaguan:TFM) .
?doc zaguan:title ?title . ?doc zaguan:date ?date .
OPTIONAL { ?doc zaguan:author ?a . ?a zaguan:nombrePersona ?autor . }
OPTIONAL { ?doc zaguan:contributor ?c . ?c zaguan:nombrePersona ?director . }
FILTER ( (BOUND(?autor) && CONTAINS(LCASE(?autor), "lópez")) || (BOUND(?director) && CONTAINS(LCASE(?director), "lópez")) )
?doc zaguan:publisher ?entidad . ?entidad zaguan:nombreEntidad ?nombreEntidad .
FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?nombreEntidad), "informática")) } LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: PREFIX xsd: PREFIX rdf: PREFIX rdfs:
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc zaguan:title ?title . ?doc zaguan:date ?date .
?doc zaguan:subject ?subj . ?subj zaguan:nombreTema ?tema .
FILTER( (CONTAINS(LCASE(?tema), "arte aragonés")) )
FILTER (?date <= "1899"^^xsd:gYear) } LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: PREFIX xsd: PREFIX rdf: PREFIX rdfs:
SELECT ?doc WHERE { ?doc zaguan:title ?title . ?doc zaguan:date ?date .
?doc zaguan:description ?desc .
FILTER( ( CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "algortimos de búsqueda") && ( CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "medicina") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "proteínas") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "sintomas") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "pacientes") )) ) } LIMIT 100
